On ceiling-high shelves in one vault, CD

plain_text:
In another vault, master recordings of
Andrés Segovia, Lawrence Welk and Bing
Crosby are etched into 16-inch lacquer
discs. Even after all of this time, they give
off a scent, despite the chill. The vaults
are kept at low temperature and humidity
to slow down degradation of materials.
